title: ReportModel
description: A caller-authored, machine-validated model that is the only structured source for human-report facts. Harness never interprets business outputs or invents report prose, but it does bind the model to the source operation result's digest, terminal state, and complete stable-coded errors.

runId.description: The machine run/operation identity this report is about.

skillFamily.description: The skill family whose run produced the underlying machine result.

stageId.description: Optional stage identity echoed from the machine result when present.

audience.description: The declared reader of the report; selection only, never a license to add facts.

locale.description: Frozen rendering locale set; an unsupported locale is a hard failure (SFC3002), never a silent fallback.

startedAt.description: RFC 3339 start time copied from the machine result; never invented by the renderer.

completedAt.description: RFC 3339 terminal time copied from the machine result; never invented by the renderer.

executionStatus.description: The machine execution status, copied verbatim from the machine result vocabulary.

summary.description: The conclusion sentence(s). A report without a conclusion is a missing element (SFC3002), never an empty render.

blockingReason.description: Present only when the machine result carries one (FAILED/BLOCKED); never invented.

counts.description: Mechanically derived section counts; must equal the array lengths below. A mismatch is fact drift.

errors.description: The source operation-result errors copied without loss. It must be empty for successful outcomes; when a source result is supplied, Harness requires canonical equality with result.errors.

changes.description: Changed artifacts declared by the machine result; may legitimately be empty. Order is preserved from the machine result.

path.description: Descriptive artifact path as stated by the machine result; rendering never reads or resolves it.

evidence.description: Traceable evidence entries; a report model without at least one evidence entry is a missing element (SFC3002).

id.description: Stable evidence identifier used for in-report referencing.

reference.description: The exact reference target of this evidence. A rendered link may only point at a declared reference or an in-report anchor; any other target is fact drift.

risks.description: Declared risks; may be empty, but the section itself is mandatory in every rendered report.

unresolved.description: Unresolved questions carried out of the run; may be empty.

nextActions.description: Follow-up actions; may be empty, but the section itself is mandatory in every rendered report.

appendices.description: Supplementary material copied from the machine result; may be empty. Never a place for renderer-added prose.

resultDigest.description: sha256 hex digest over the canonical JSON of the source machine result document.

resultState.description: The terminal state copied verbatim from the source operation result. Harness verifies it and the compatible human executionStatus without interpreting outputs.

resultKind.description: Optional kind discriminator of the source machine result document.

name.description: Identity of the deterministic renderer that produced the model.

version.description: Exact semver of the renderer; no ranges.
